{{SameName|Sin|[[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Sin|Pizza Party]]}} {{EventEnded|date = 21st of December 2023|event = [[Lunar Overture Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Sin |image1 = Sin.png |mode_appearance = [[The Haunted Past|Lunar Overture Act II]] |first_wave_appearance = N/A |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]400 (Small)
[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]800 (Big) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4, Small)
[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (Big) |spawned_by = *[[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]] *[[Reaper (Lunar Overture)|Reaper]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Burn}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Sin''' is an enemy that only appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It did not spawn naturally, instead being spawned by other enemies. It had two variants, a small variant which had 400 health and a large variant with 800 health. The small variant also had an above average speed, while the big variant had below average speed. The '''Sin''' was spawned by the [[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]] upon its death, but only the small variant. It could also be summoned by the [[Reaper (Lunar Overture)|Reaper]], which could summon both the small and big variant. ==Appearance== The '''Sin''' had a small humanoid with it's black and red magma body, with a head that had an open mouth with jagged teeth and a pair of horns. The interior of the head was glowing yellow. It also had a small tail. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] are useful against this. *Towers with sufficient damage and range, such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Ranger]], are also viable due to the fact that the '''Sin''' may occasionally leak through defense as they are accompanied by large hordes of enemies with substantial health. *As these spawn in hordes, splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Pursuit]] can be very useful here. *Do note that you do not earn any money from the '''Sin''' as it is a summoned enemy. **The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] can still generate cash from '''Sins''' with its Cash Shot, but not by damaging them. ***However, these towers have their income reduced in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]], making them much less effective. ==Trivia== *The '''Sin''' and the [[Pumpkid]] are some of the smallest enemies in the game. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]g **'''Sin''' added. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Sin''' removed. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:The Haunted Past]] [[Category:Lunar Overture]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Sin}}
